The opisthokonts (from Ancient Greek ὀπίσθιος ( opísthios ) ' rear, posterior ' and κοντός ( kontós ) ' pole, flagellum ' ) are a broad group of eukaryotes , including both the animal and fungus kingdoms . [ 5 ] The opisthokonts, previously called the "Fungi/Metazoa group", [ 6 ] are generally recognized as a clade . Opisthokonts together with Apusomonadida and Breviata make up the larger clade Obazoa . [ 7 ] [ 8 ] [ 9 ] [ 10 ] [ 11 ]
